info.description:
Automated cryptocurrency purchasing platform: schedule recurring USDT buys (daily/weekly/biweekly/monthly), executed on Binance with KYC gating, encrypted key storage, and full transaction history.

All protected endpoints expect `Authorization: Bearer <access token>`. Validation failures return **422**; rate limits return **429** with `Retry-After`. Full guides: `docs/API.md`, `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md`.
info.title: AutoBuy Crypto API

post.description:
Make an Auto-Buy purchase due immediately (the next execute_purchases
run picks it up). A failed purchase is re-armed: status back to active and
the attempt counter reset. Refused for withdrawal_failed / needs_info:
those buys already filled and re-arming would buy again — the owner (or
an admin acting as them) must use retry-withdrawal instead.

Clear a needs_review purchase after checking the exchange:

- record_fill: the exchange shows the order FILLED and the fill passes the
  guard -> recorded as the buy (never re-bought), schedule resumes, and for
  withdraw-immediately purchases the withdrawal is sent now;
- mark_not_sent: the exchange shows NOT FOUND or CANCELLED -> the attempt is
  marked failed and the purchase is due again (a new buy, after the usual
  reconciliation);
- cancel: stop the purchase; the attempt stays on record.
Every resolution is audited with the admin's note.

post.description:

``skipped_paused`` in /health.
Clear the pause switch; both schedulers execute again from their next run.

post.description: Change the password and invalidate every token issued before now.

Email a one-hour password reset link. Always answers `{sent: true}`
so the response cannot be used to discover which emails have accounts.

Authenticate with email/password. The body carries the short-lived access
token (keep it in memory) and a CSRF token; the refresh token is set as an
httpOnly cookie scoped to /api/auth.

Sign out: revoke the refresh token from the cookie server-side and clear
both session cookies. Needs the X-CSRF-Token header. The short-lived access
token simply expires. Always 204, even when no cookie was sent.

Silent session refresh: needs the refresh cookie and the X-CSRF-Token
header matching the CSRF cookie. Answers a new access token and rotates
both cookies (the previous refresh token is revoked). 401 without a valid
cookie, 403 without a valid CSRF header.
Register a new user with email and password.

Set a new password using a reset token from `/forgot-password`.
The token is single-use and expires after an hour; on success every
existing session is signed out.

Check a reset token without consuming it: 200 `{valid: true}` when
`/reset-password` would accept it, 400 `{valid: false}` otherwise. Lets
the reset page show the expired-link state before asking for a password.

post.description:
Create a purchase. `purchase_type` selects the mode: `autobuy` (default:
buy, then withdraw the coins to `wallet_address`, which is required) or
`dca` (buy and accumulate on the exchange; no wallet needed — one may be
given for a later switch). Rejects (422 with `{error, details}`) when a
wallet address does not match the chain's format, is a known burn address,
when Bitget has no online USDT pair for the coin, when the order is below
Bitget's minimum, when the chain is not withdrawable, when the amount after
fees is below Bitget's minimum withdrawal (autobuy), or when the exchange
account is not the caller's.

delete.description:
Cancel a purchase. The record and its transaction history are kept;
the scheduler will never execute it again.

get.description: One purchase with its full transaction history (newest first).

put.description:
Pause (`status: paused`), resume (`status: active`), change amount/frequency,
or switch mode. Switching to `autobuy` (withdraw immediately) requires
`wallet_address`, `blockchain_network` and `confirm_wallet_address` equal to
the address; the address must be valid, spendable and supported by the
exchange. Cancelled, completed and failed purchases cannot be changed.

post.description:
Send the coins of the last filled buy to the wallet again. Only for
purchases parked as `withdrawal_failed` or `needs_info`; the buy is never
repeated. The wallet, chain and Bitget minimum are re-checked first. On
success the purchase becomes `active` again and the schedule resumes; a
failed retry leaves it parked with the new error. Runs in dry-run mode
when AUTOBUY_DRY_RUN is set (nothing is sent).

The raw body is verified against ``x-payload-digest`` using the algorithm

get.description:
Health check endpoint for monitoring.

``schedulers`` reports the admin pause switch and the Auto-Buy
execute_purchases job from the Redis heartbeat, so the values are the same
whichever worker answers: running / paused, last run time, last result
(``ok`` | ``failed`` | ``error`` | ``skipped_paused``), last counts and the
consecutive-failure count.
